hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/greenbrier.aspx ('Forty sites have electric hookups') + parkreservations.maryland.gov per-site catalog for parkId 380112 (all 39 Campsite Electric sites, Cedar Loop, list Electrical Service 30 amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DNR says 165 campsites (elsewhere 164), 40 with electric; the booking site lists 150 bookable campsites in four loops (Cedar 39 electric; Ash, Birch, Dogwood non-electric). Listed max vehicle lengths are mostly 24-40 ft, a few 45-60 ft. The electric sites are all listed back-in.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/greenbrier.aspx + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/greenbrier-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380112 (site list and each site's details page), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/greenbrier.aspx ('fresh water and bathhouses in each camp loop'; 'bathhouses with hot showers'; 'A dump station is available'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DNR's park page: 'Reservations are required.' The booking page: campsites 'must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.' The park gate closes at sunset; late arrivals call the park.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/greenbrier.aspx (Camping) + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/greenbrier-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380112 (Booking Window for Campsite Electric / Non-Electric), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Maryland's Golden Age Pass gives seniors half-price camping Sunday through Thursday nights.

discounts.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/greenbrier.aspx ('Seniors citizens with a valid Golden Age Pass receive a half price discount on camping when staying Sunday through Thursday'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed fees on the booking table ($21.50/$27.50 electric, +$1 weekends) and the inherited 365-day window. Added 30-amp electric, 165 sites to 60 ft (electric sites back-in), showers, water, dump, reservations required (fcfs never over the inherited 'always'), booking closes 1 day before arrival, and the Golden Age Pass half-price weeknight note. Not stated: season dates on the park page (RA shows open through Oct 31 2026), water/sewer at sites, min/max stay for this park.
